interpretation: R_disp here is pure biological + segmentation jitter (pairs already MNI-aligned). If the floor approaches the 1.0mm cut, the gate false-rejects clean pairs; if well below, the cut has margin. NOTE: most pairs are UNMEASURABLE (fewer than 3 large well-spread stable fiducials) -> the gate fails closed on them, which is correct but means the lesion-scale gate can certify only a minority of real MS pairs.
